execution_blueprint.name: deterministic_agent_operating_spec_compiler
execution_blueprint.purpose: Transform a raw prompt into an agent-runnable operational specification for deterministic AI orchestration.
execution_blueprint.source_prompt_intent: Compile the LangGraph + Cloudflare + Next.js Mission Control OS prompt into an executable architecture/specification bundle without fabricated verification, APIs, tool calls, or production readiness.

runtime_positioning.rule: Treat orchestration as deterministic and model outputs as confidence-scored artifacts.

core_operating_rules: Bind claims to evidence or mark them unverified.
Classify every task as retry_safe, guarded_retry, or non_retryable.
Require human approval for irreversible, production, credential, external-write, regulated, or low-confidence actions.
Use [VOID_DETECTED] for missing docs, unknown APIs, absent repo context, and unavailable verification.
Never fabricate tool proof, citations, endpoints, SDKs, package versions, logs, benchmarks, or release readiness.

minimum_executable_architecture.backend_layer: Python/FastAPI/Pydantic or equivalent; LangGraph after repo/runtime verification
minimum_executable_architecture.orchestration_layer: FSM/XState-style state machine plus task DAG
minimum_executable_architecture.streaming_layer: SSE or verified equivalent with monotonic offsets and replay
minimum_executable_architecture.edge_layer: Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects/Workflows only if bindings are verified
minimum_executable_architecture.observability_layer: execution trace schema, claim registry, tool proof log, failure-mode signals

blocking_conditions: No repository was provided for implementation-specific validation.
SEC dissent blocks production deployment and unverified tool execution.
Manual schema validity was structured but not executed through a runtime validator.
safe_next_steps: Provide repository access for implementation planning.
Verify Cloudflare bindings and deployment topology.
Verify optional external provider APIs before adapter generation.
Run schema validation with code execution if a machine-readable bundle is exported.
Request implementation bundle explicitly if production code generation is desired.
